text:
Sergei: heads-up, onboarding redwood-staging subscription in eastus2 blocked by ND40rs_v2 quota and regional availability.
Maria: what did provisioning return?
Sergei: ARM error on VMSS creation: "Allocation failed: VM size 'Standard_ND40rs_v2' not available in location 'eastus2' for subscription 'sub-abc123'". Opened Azure support case 2123456789.
AJ: could be either quota or physical capacity. Did you check usage and SKUs?
Sergei: quota shows 0; az cli shows SKU not listed for subscription in eastus2. Azure account team flagged "capacity pressure" for ND40rs_v2, suggested capacity reservation request.
Nina: also hit NSG limit while attaching the subnet: "Network security group rule limit reached (100)". Our staging net has many ip-based allow rules.
Infra-Bot: azure-case-created 2123456789 owner=Sergei severity=high
Maria: plan: 1) escalate support case asking for both quota bump and capacity reservation 2) run NSG consolidation (INFRA-501) 3) prepare constrained canary in fallback region if reservation takes too long.
Sergei: claimed INFRA-500 to track quota/reservation; linking Azure case. INFRA-501 for NSG cleanup.
Sales-Eng: pinging account team. Draft note to partners: "Redwood Inference requests increase to 8x Standard_ND40rs_v2 in eastus2 and a capacity reservation from 2026-05-10 for 6 weeks. Case 2123456789. Please provide availability window and reservation pricing tiers."
AJ: quick checks I ran:
```
az vm list-usage --location eastus2 --subscription sub-abc123 | grep -i ND40rs_v2
az vm list-skus --location eastus2 --size Standard_ND40rs_v2 --subscription sub-abc123
``` 
Sergei: account team asked for our expected throughput; replied with canary qps and 1yr commit intent.
Nina: NSG quick fix: convert per-IP rules to service tags and application security groups. Example ARM fragment:
```
{
  "name": "AllowLoadBalancer",
  "properties": {
    "priority": 100,
    "direction": "Inbound",
    "access": "Allow",
    "sourceAddressPrefix": "AzureLoadBalancer",
    "destinationPortRange": "443"
  }
}
```
Maria: if Azure can only give partial quota (e.g., 4/8) we can do a small canary and validate cache sharding. Need product signoff on limited rollout.
Sales-Eng: partner call estimate: 8x ND40rs_v2 reserved 1yr ~ $95k/mo ballpark. Will get formal quote.
AJ: alternative mitigation: mixed fleet with ND24s for non-cache-bound replicas. Tradeoff: model parallel performance drops.
Sergei: added timeline requirement to the case: need reservation confirmation by 2026-05-01 to keep canary schedule. Escalated to account team.
Infra-Bot: azure-case-updated 2123456789 status=Escalated note="Account team engaged; investigating capacity reservation options"
Cloud-Ops-Bot: reminder: NSG consolidation due 2026-04-04
Nina: submitted parallel quota request in westus3 as fallback. If eastus2 is partial we'll split the canary but need KV-cache affinity changes.
Maria: I'll prep a short impact note for product and growth. If timeline slips we'll push canary and inform stakeholders.
Sergei: updating INFRA-500 and will paste account team responses here.
Sales-Eng: tagging partner rep; asked for reservation timeline and price bands.
Maria: thanks everyone. Please keep updates tight — post summary to #product-launch tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
